description: tutor session hooks. Bash-only (shell form): the interpreter is picked with `command -v`, which PowerShell cannot parse — on Windows that means Git Bash. Silent no-op when no python is on PATH, and outside a teach workspace.

hooks.command: P="$(command -v python || command -v python3)"; [ -n "$P" ] || exit 0; "$P" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/teach_hook.py" --event session-start
P="$(command -v python || command -v python3)"; [ -n "$P" ] || exit 0; "$P" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/teach_hook.py" --event stop
